ma.writeBLECharacteristicValue(Object object)

Write binary data to Bluetooth Low Energy device characteristics (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
deviceId String Yes Bluetooth device id
serviceId String Yes The UUID of the service corresponding to the Bluetooth feature
characteristicId String Yes Bluetooth characteristic UUID
value ArrayBuffer Yes Binary value corresponding to Bluetooth device characteristics
writeType String No Write mode setting for Bluetooth characteristic values. The default value for iOS is write, and the default value for Android is writeNoResponse.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

writeType Valid Values

Attribute Description
write Forced reply writing, reporting an error is not supported
writeNoResponse It is mandatory to write without reply, and it will report an error if it is not supported.
signedWrite Force signature when writing

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String writeBLECharacteristicValue: ok

Sample Code

let buffer = new ArrayBuffer(1)
let dataView = new DataView(buffer)
dataView.setUint8(0, 0)

ma.writeBLECharacteristicValue({
  deviceId,
  serviceId,
  characteristicId,
  value: buffer,
  success(res) {
    console.log('writeBLECharacteristicValue success', res.errMsg)
  }
})

Tips

  1. The characteristics of the device must support write before it can be called successfully.
  2. For IOS models, according to the current BLE protocol, it is recommended that the amount of data transmitted in a single time should not exceed 20 bytes. When the transmitted data is large, it is recommended to perform fragmentation processing.
